Thanks for the heads-up, Emma — we can do that. Quick proposal: compress the agenda to 35 minutes and prioritize the runtime demo, cost controls, and a 10-minute exec Q&A at the end for Lydia. Suggested agenda:

- 0–5m: quick intros and objectives
- 5–20m: runtime demo (low-latency path + KV caching)
- 20–30m: cost/ops controls (batching, quantization recommendations)
- 30–35m: exec Q&A (Lydia joins here)

Marissa and Karthik — can you two run the runtime demo/device handoff? If Lydia can only join remotely for the last 20 minutes, we should plan to screen-share the exec slides at 28m so she sees the summary.

I'll send an updated invite with a shortened calendar entry and attach the 2-slide "exec highlights" so she can skim during transit.

-Jasmine
